payload.label: Save a web page as a clip
payload.job: Save a web page in the person's Files as a clip: its address, title, text, a snapshot picture when the page-reading tool draws one, and a refresh policy
payload.description: Reads the page with tool:read-a-page-in-my-browser and keeps it as one file in the person's Files under /Saved pages, with an index row. Saving the same address again replaces its record. Returns the record and its file.

url.description: The http or https address of the page

refresh_every_hours.description: Whole hours between refreshes; null for no refresh

payload.label: Read a saved web page
payload.job: Read one saved web page by address or key, or list every saved page
payload.description: With neither url nor key, lists every saved page from the index. Changes nothing.

url.description: The http or https address of the page

key.description: The saved page key from read-saved-page, instead of its address

payload.label: Edit a saved web page
payload.job: Change a saved page's refresh policy or title
payload.description: Changes only refresh_every_hours or title; the text and snapshot are kept.

url.description: The http or https address of the page

key.description: The saved page key from read-saved-page, instead of its address

refresh_every_hours.description: Whole hours between refreshes; null for no refresh

payload.label: Refresh saved web pages
payload.job: Read again the saved pages whose refresh time has come, or the one asked for
payload.description: A page that fails keeps its last good text and title and records why. Put it on a schedule to keep clips current. Uses tool:read-a-page-in-my-browser for each page read.

url.description: The http or https address of the page

key.description: The saved page key from read-saved-page, instead of its address

payload.label: Find a link's provider
payload.job: Say which registered provider a pasted address belongs to
payload.description: Names the provider by the address's host, the saved lists it feeds and the names of the values its sign-in uses, never the values. An address no provider handles is refused, naming the registered ones.

url.description: The http or https address of the page
